objective: Test whether the current exact Ministral artifact can complete a comparable dual-GPU layer workload at one declared context after the prior Issue #44 OOM/timeout diagnostics.

coverage_decisions.single_gpu: Not selected: prior Issue #44 single-GPU OOM is retained as a bounded historical observation; current exact target capability is not inferred as a publication claim.
coverage_decisions.dual_gpu: Selected: Vulkan0,Vulkan1, -sm layer, -ts 1,1; tensor/row split excluded by project policy.
coverage_decisions.context: One same-context candidate at 1024; upstream 262144 is not local capacity evidence.
coverage_decisions.kv: Default f16 K/V baseline only; no blind KV sweep.

stop_rule: Stop at the first unexpected result; preserve the terminal classification and do not retry blindly.

publication.requirement: All publication metrics must use context 1024; no mixed-context evidence is eligible.
